 The Honourable Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Writ Petition No.35214 of 2025
Order:

This Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
".....to issue an appropriate writ, Order or direction, particularly a Writ of Mandamus declaring action of the respondent Nos. 3 to 5 in trying to dispossessing the petitioner from his land admeasuring Ac.0.44 cents in survey No. 66/A-1 B of Nagireddypalle Revenue Village, Peddamudiam Mandal, YSR Kadapa District, without there being any land acquisition proceedings or any recourse to law, without invoking the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, as illegal, irregular, unjust, high handed besides arbitrary and violative of Articles 14 and 21 of Constitution of India and consequently direct the respondent Nos. 3 to 5 not to form any road from petitioner's land admeasuring Ac.0.44 cents in survey No. 66/A-1 B of Nagireddypalle Revenue Village, Peddamudiam Mandal, YSR Kadapa District, without there being any land acquisition proceedings or any recourse to law...."
